gaps.title: Resolve provider use rights and actual data coverage
gaps.ma_concept: Free-first per-kind chains, optional paid fallback and ten-year history.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP-10; docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md CAP-01; L3-S01; exact Grow tier and rights unresolved.
gaps.recommendation: Keep Yahoo plus requested Grow as candidate sources. Require a per-listing/per-use rights matrix and fallback-to-daily/unavailable. Grow pricing/terms do not establish non-display ML rights for this use; request provider clarification. No paid upgrade or LLM transmission assumed.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve verified source/tier/rights and taxed GBP recurring envelope, or choose reduced coverage before architecture freeze.
acceptance_criteria: Record quote/NAV/history/actions/exposures/news capability, delay, cadence, credit weight and storage/training/derived-data/Anthropic-sharing permission per source.
Expose unsupported/stale states; no automatic provider upgrade.
Verify UK/US/India examples and compare full monthly costs against £70 operating allowance and £100 total ceiling.

gaps.title: Define every forecast target and maturity contract
gaps.ma_concept: One principal four-week horizon plus analog 5/20/60-day outcomes.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md ForecastTask/Horizon; L4-S01; selected horizons exist without fully agreed target formulas.
gaps.recommendation: Define daily as-of origins for next-day, 5-20 trading-day and 3/6/12-calendar-month tasks. Specify terminal total return versus within-horizon drawdown as separate targets; 3-5-year outputs are conditional scenarios. Thirty-minute monitoring never creates a fresh formal forecast by implication.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve target catalogue, horizon list, origin cutoff, calendars, total-return convention and event thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Each task pins target equation/unit, origin/cutoff, calendar roll, maturity, canonical source, baseline and metrics.
Distinguish terminal loss from maximum drawdown, cost-basis loss and portfolio peak drawdown.
Fixtures cover holidays, split/dividend, delayed NAV, FX and stale origins.

gaps.title: Make historical datasets genuinely point in time
gaps.ma_concept: F1 ten-year Parquet lake with known-at data and exposure maps.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md F1; L3-S02; source vintage availability unproven.
gaps.recommendation: Require three times for observations (economic, known-at/publication, ingestion), revision lineage and versioned universe/exposures. Current adjusted prices, macro revisions, constituents and LLM extraction cannot be silently projected into past origins.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve first feature/data catalogue and classify sources as vintage-backed, lag-conservative, prospective-only or unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Dataset manifest records source/query/cutoff/content hashes, actions and universe/exposure versions.
Delisted/merged instruments and discontinued funds are addressed; missing history is explicit.
Contaminated or reconstructable-only features excluded from claimed historical edge; prospective evidence separate.

gaps.title: Specify a bounded experiment and leakage-control protocol
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md F2; L4-S03; exact folds/search/selection limits open.
gaps.recommendation: Choose rolling/expanding chronological origins with label-interval purging and training-only transformations. Group instruments by common time boundaries, account for serial/cross-asset dependence, record all trials and limit search. Final holdout is untouched until a frozen candidate comparison.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve fold schedule per horizon, search budget, selection loss, uncertainty method and final-test reuse policy.
acceptance_criteria: Leakage challenge cases fail for revised macro, future constituents, overlapping labels and extraction hindsight.
All transforms/features/calibrators fit within permissible training data.
Report paired baseline deltas, effective sample limits, subgroup performance and experiment count, not a best backtest alone.

gaps.title: Fix the initial model catalogue without inventing model counts
gaps.ma_concept: F3-F5 mood/risk/analogs/direction described as several conceptual models.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/architecture-deep-dive.md proposes two CPU trainable families; no approved per-task model registry.
gaps.recommendation: Retain deterministic rules/statistical benchmarks and propose two CPU trainable families: regularised linear/logistic baselines and gradient-boosted/quantile challengers. Regime definitions and analog/event engines are explicit modules. Exact class/task/horizon artefacts follow evidence, not one model per ticker. SageMaker selection is separate infrastructure decision.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve candidate families, supported tasks, training cadence and bounded experiment count before final cost model.
acceptance_criteria: Catalogue separates rules, statistics, learned estimators, calibration and explanations.
Each artefact has task/horizon/kind/eligible-universe/features/schema/dependencies/resource cap.
Do not claim one trained object serves every market/horizon or that two families equal only two artefacts.

gaps.title: Make analog and event evidence horizon-aware
gaps.ma_concept: Thirty nearest neighbours excluding last20days; low-evidence label below8events.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md explicitly flags horizon-aware exclusion and sparse event caveat; L4-S04.
gaps.recommendation: Retain analog explanations but exclude candidates whose target outcome was not known at the origin; overlap/effective sample and distances must be visible. Event windows and confounding need predeclared definitions; eight events is not proof of an edge.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve analog feature/distance/window, weighting, de-overlap and sparse-evidence rules.
acceptance_criteria: Separate descriptive historical associations from causal claims.
Report sample dates/count/effective dependence, similarity, outcomes/interval and coverage.
Events known after the prediction origin cannot select the study cohort.

gaps.title: Separate rule strength from calibrated forecast probability
gaps.ma_concept: Heuristic confidence formula shown as percentage and daily map tuning.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md already separates rule strength and owner-approved calibration; L4-S02/L4-S05/L4-S08.
gaps.recommendation: Keep rule strength as a labelled heuristic until its event definition and calibration evidence are approved. Calibrators train on held-out chronological predictions; evaluate proper scores, reliability and interval coverage/width by horizon and important subgroup. No daily live recalibration without owner permission.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve calibration methods, loss functions, reliability bins/minimum evidence and rollback policy.
acceptance_criteria: No rule percentage silently displayed as P(up).
Report Brier/log loss versus event base rates and range coverage plus sharpness; abstain where unsupported.
Calibration version and approval bind every released forecast; model and calibrator cannot silently diverge.

gaps.title: Design long-horizon investment inference independently of the four-week model
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md adds3/6/12months and3-5year scenarios; target-specific evidence not complete.
gaps.recommendation: Use horizon-specific targets, data sufficiency and benchmarks. For long horizons consider simple valuation/fundamental/macro summaries only where licensed and truly known at time; compare against historical/constant-return and risk baselines. Scenarios use explicit contribution/return/inflation/FX assumptions, not fabricated confidence.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve scope/inputs/benchmarks for each long horizon and what may remain unavailable pending evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Keep all agreed horizons in requirements; do not replace them with20-day outputs.
Display evaluated forecasts versus conditional scenarios with different labels and provenance.
Account for few independent12-month outcomes and avoid claiming10years means thousands of independent yearly examples.

gaps.title: Replace calendar-only practice gates with evidence and approval
gaps.ma_concept: Eight live weeks above base rate/rules, automatic switch-off after four weak weeks.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md explicitly supersedes eight-week proof and automatic promotion; L4-S08.
gaps.recommendation: Define task-specific shadow minimums using mature outcomes, effective independence, baseline deltas and confidence, plus owner promotion. Preapprove a narrow safety-disable route; distinguish data outage/model-ineligible from statistical deterioration.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve entry/promotion/monitoring/pause/rollback criteria and evidence minimums by horizon.
acceptance_criteria: Eight weeks cannot validate a12-month forecast.
Promotion references immutable data/model/calibration/evaluation evidence and previous safe version.
Safety disable preserves immutable forecasts and marks affected displays; return to live follows approved policy.

gaps.title: Close realised-performance and benchmark accounting decisions
gaps.ma_concept: Dated-flow XIRR from MA wealth maths.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/layered-development-2026-11-01/portfolio-import-spec.md L1-Q01/Q05/Q06/Q10 and L3-S03 already capture unresolved semantics.
gaps.recommendation: Reuse MP ledger boundary decisions; define portfolio/account/holding XIRR separately and benchmark contributions with matched dates/currencies. Retained dividends, reinvestment and transfers are not duplicate external flows. Add time-weighted comparison only when valuation evidence supports it; no extrapolated missing history.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve rounding/residual tolerances, FX timing, terminal valuation, root ambiguity, benchmark and supported performance methods.
acceptance_criteria: Golden cases include same-day, missing history, multiple roots, internal transfer, fees/dividends and FX.
Reconcile booked cash/cost basis separately from quote-adjusted total-return series.
State unavailable per metric and preserve working/provenance; XIRR never serves as predictive probability.

gaps.title: Specify portfolio exposure and risk without false precision
gaps.ma_concept: Look-through, HHI, overlap, currency and kind-specific driver maps.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md CAP-08; L3-S04 and L6-S02 are broad drafts.
gaps.recommendation: Define portfolio snapshots, weight basis, partial coverage, cash and cross-listed exposure before ranking. Separate instrument trading currency from underlying economic exposure and hedging. Estimate correlations/covariance on aligned eligible data with declared shrinkage/missingness and stress alternatives.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve exposure completeness thresholds, risk windows and benchmark/weight conventions.
acceptance_criteria: Double-listed securities and fund overlap do not double-count underlying economic risk.
Coverage residual and source age visible; absent exposure is not zero.
Show investment versus FX return effects and use partial-data abstention for unsupported portfolio-risk estimates.

gaps.title: Make ranked actions a deterministic versioned decision policy
gaps.ma_concept: Stance cascade, protected positions and contribution steering.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md CAP-03/CAP-09; owner weights growth35/protection40/opportunity25; detailed mapping open.
gaps.recommendation: Define component eligibility/scaling and action semantics before combining scores. Growth/risk/benchmark evidence must be comparable or explicitly unavailable. Distinguish forecast probability, preference-weighted ranking and portfolio constraint; explain conflicts and ask owner for any change.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve score normalisation, abstention/conflict policy, concentration/contribution constraints and recommendation wording.
acceptance_criteria: Show component scores/weights/source/version and counterfactual portfolio impact.
Missing component does not silently earn neutral/full score; disclose approved renormalisation policy.
No trade execution, universal sell-everything instruction, tax-rule assumptions or autonomous contribution changes.

gaps.title: Evaluate LLM-derived news factors separately from narrative quality
gaps.ma_concept: Haiku batches tag stories and exposure code scores relevance.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md R0/M1/M2/M3 ablation ladder; L5-S01; exact schemas/datasets/usage rights open.
gaps.recommendation: Freeze extraction schema/entity links/source rights, publication/extraction times and model/prompt versions. Test extraction accuracy and downstream incremental predictive value separately. Historical extraction by a newer LLM is potentially hindsight-contaminated; prospective shadow is the default when contamination cannot be bounded.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve factor catalogue, labelled extraction sample, provenance requirements, relevance floor and ablation criteria.
acceptance_criteria: No live-risk dependency on a batch not guaranteed complete by deadline.
Every financial number and relevance weight computed from authorised typed inputs.
LLM judge cannot manufacture price ground truth or override promotion/admission controls.

gaps.title: Treat patterns as tested features rather than asserted alpha
gaps.ma_concept: F8 candles/charts/technical features with per-holding event studies.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md F8; L4-S06; full detector/confirmation specification pending.
gaps.recommendation: Preserve pattern research concept but predefine detector, lag, confirmation, parameter grid and eligible kinds. Compare incremental effect against simple trend/risk baseline after multiple-testing controls and costs. NAV-only funds get only compatible line patterns.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve initial bounded pattern set and promotion/retirement evidence; wider catalogue remains planned.
acceptance_criteria: No look-ahead extrema or chart labelling using future bars.
Hand-marked detector cases separate from out-of-sample value tests.
Source-adjustment/corporate-action artefacts and thin trading do not create fake pattern signals.

gaps.title: Validate each market and instrument family before extension
gaps.ma_concept: India market basket, free NAV and CAS; new kinds plugged into registry.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md initialUS/UK/India and futureAsia/Europe contracts; PH-09 broad.
gaps.recommendation: Make exchange/session/calendar, corporate-action/unit/price semantics, entitlements, historical universe and test evidence explicit capabilities. India is part of initial requirements rather than a copied final phase. Each future market/theme/model follows approved extension checklist with separate source/cost validity.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve v1 supported kinds, India NAV scope, exchange calendars and per-market readiness tests; defer unsupported families explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: US/UK/India each has source/identity/FX/action/calendar/forecast evidence examples.
GBX versus GBP, NSE/BSE linkage, accumulation/distribution and direct/regular mutual-fund plans are distinct.
Future China/Taiwan/HK/Europe configuration cannot bypass rights or scientific gates.

gaps.title: Fix the forecast information contract before drawing screens
gaps.ma_concept: Risk-first forecasts, proof page, model sheets and unavailable/in-practice states.
gaps.mp_evidence: docs/planning/aws-options-2026-11-01/forecasting-scope.md CAP-10/CAP-16 and L6-S03; MA board choices not MP-approved.
gaps.recommendation: Agree content/state and provenance contracts before UX. Preserve forecast/proof/track record plus disagreement, stale, insufficient history, no-clear-view, disabled, corrected-outcome and cost-paused states. Actual layout/style/options come later.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve information hierarchy, action labels and required proof/state payloads; do not approve MA branding or mock values.
acceptance_criteria: Each displayed number identifies task/as-of/source/model and whether evaluated, illustrative or scenario.
Proof contains dataset/fold/baseline/mature outcomes/eligibility and limitations, with accessible text alternatives.
Chat deep-links exact evidence context; offline/stale data cannot masquerade as fresh analysis.

research.title: Twelve Data individual pricing
research.claim: The current page lists Grow at $79 monthly with internal display, US real-time and global EOD coverage; it lists internal non-display under Ultra. This is not a per-instrument entitlement determination.
research.mp_implication: Verify the exact Grow tier, exchange coverage and non-display/training/storage uses in writing before live use; do not infer UK/India intraday or silently upgrade.

research.title: Twelve Data terms, sections 2 and 3
research.claim: Data processing, retention, display, non-display and third-party permissions depend on the subscribed rights and applicable source terms.
research.mp_implication: Add a capability/use-rights register covering training, derived data, AWS storage and sending evidence to Anthropic; obtain clarification rather than treating this review as legal approval.

research.title: yfinance maintainer README
research.claim: The library is independent of Yahoo and directs users to Yahoo terms for actual data rights; library licensing does not establish market-data permission.
research.mp_implication: Use Yahoo as a capability-checked research source, with explicit permitted use and failure/staleness handling; no uptime/history promise.

research.title: FRED observations and vintage_dates
research.claim: Observation requests can retrieve historical vintages or initial releases instead of only latest revisions.
research.mp_implication: Store observation time, publication/known-at time and ingestion time; replay only data genuinely available at each origin.

research.title: Forecasting: Principles and Practice, forecasting toolbox
research.claim: Forecast accuracy should be evaluated at rolling origins using only earlier observations; multi-step evaluation must match the intended forecast task.
research.mp_implication: Use chronological multi-horizon validation, matched baselines and horizon-specific metrics rather than random splits or one four-week gate.

research.title: scikit-learn TimeSeriesSplit
research.claim: The splitter supports ordered folds and a configurable gap, but is a generic splitter rather than a complete financial leakage policy.
research.mp_implication: Specify label-interval purging and grouped-calendar alignment explicitly; a fixed gap is not proof that overlapping long-horizon labels are separated.

research.title: scikit-learn probability calibration
research.claim: Calibrators should use independent predictions rather than fitting the training scores of the classifier.
research.mp_implication: Fit calibrators only on chronological held-out/out-of-fold predictions inside the training process; protect the final test.

research.title: Gibbs and Candes, Conformal Inference for Online Prediction with Arbitrary Distribution Shifts
research.claim: The research studies adaptive prediction sets under distribution shift; its guarantees depend on the defined procedure and coverage target.
research.mp_implication: Evaluate interval calibration, width and regime/horizon coverage; do not market generic conformal ranges as per-holding conditional guarantees.

research.title: Goyal and Welch, equity premium prediction
research.claim: Their historical study found weak out-of-sample performance for the examined predictors relative to a historical-average benchmark.
research.mp_implication: Treat return predictability as an empirical hypothesis and retain simple baselines; this historical result is not a theorem that all present models fail.

research.title: Campbell and Thompson, out-of-sample equity-premium prediction
research.claim: Their study found that economically motivated restrictions can yield small useful out-of-sample gains, while long weak periods remain possible.
research.mp_implication: Seek measured incremental usefulness with uncertainty; do not promise highly accurate direction or assume complexity creates an edge.

research.title: Bailey et al., The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
research.claim: Selecting among many backtested configurations can overfit even when the reported chosen configuration looks strong.
research.mp_implication: Record all trials and selection rules, bound search and preserve untouched chronological evaluation; do not repeatedly tune to the same final holdout.

research.title: Microsoft XIRR
research.claim: XIRR estimates an annualised return from dated cash flows and uses a 365-day year convention.
research.mp_implication: Specify cash-flow scope, terminal valuation, solver and ambiguity behaviour; it describes realised money-weighted performance, not forecast probability.

research.title: Forecasting: Principles and Practice, judgmental/scenario forecasting
research.claim: Structured judgment has defined uses and biases; forecasting tasks and assumptions should be documented and evaluated.
research.mp_implication: Show 3-5-year conditional scenarios with explicit assumptions separately from statistically evaluated 3/6/12-month forecasts.

risks: Page/concept reconciliation is not independent scientific validation or source acceptance-clause parity.
Provider rights, price/tax/FX and exact instrument coverage remain unresolved until owner/provider confirmation.
No empirical model fitting/backtest/paid calls ran; all scientific recommendations need measured evidence later.
Existing140source-story register preserves detailed original wording; these16gaps are planning work packages, not a new140story completion certificate.
recommended_signoff_order: Resolve rights and cost feasibility first
Approve bounded candidate/evaluation/abstention and model-change policy
Decompose each phase into real linked MP stories and evidence before UX
